turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi there, it's Ryan Clarke calling from BrightRoof Energy. Am I speaking with the homeowner?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Er, yes, I suppose. What's this about?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great! We're in your area this week offering free solar assessments. Homeowners near you are cutting their energy bills by up to seventy percent.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Seventy percent? That sounds a bit much. Where did you get my number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We work from local area lists. Now, how much is your electricity bill each month, roughly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd rather not say. I wasn't expecting a sales call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Totally understand. Most people pay around a hundred and fifty. With our panels that could drop to almost nothing, and there's no upfront cost at all.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing upfront means a loan, doesn't it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's a simple finance plan, and the savings cover the payments. But this offer is only open until Friday, so I'd love to book the assessment today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't make decisions like that on the phone. Can you send me something in writing?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, but the price is only guaranteed if we lock in a visit now. What's your full name, so I can reserve it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Margaret Ellis. But I'm not agreeing to anything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No commitment at all. And the address, so the surveyor knows where to go?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not giving you my address. Just email me the details.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our system needs an address for the booking. Your neighbours have already signed up. You don't want to miss out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I said no. How much would it actually cost in total, with the interest?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That depends on the roof. The surveyor explains all of that on the visit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So you can't tell me. Then I'm not interested.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I at least call you back next week when you've had time to think?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No. Please take my number off your list.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Right. I'll make a note. Thanks for your time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Goodbye.
